The scarf itself is big enough that holding it from my shoulders, it goes all the way down past my knees (roughly measured, something like 34 inches wide by 38 inches long). The fabric is semi-sheer and very soft, 100% polyester. Because of its simplicity and neutral print, I expect it would look good on anyone. It is well stitched and constructed. The thread is the same gray as the background. There are no dangling threads or pilling or rips. I think its a sturdy thing. Im not worried about damaging it or having to treat it with delicacy. Its a great cool spring or early fall scarf, and it could be worn in winter too, in part because of its size. You just bundle up in it. Its big as a blanket.
